name.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a staff member's name.

role.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a staff member's role: Pastor, Elder…

position.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for where a staff member stands in the site's list.

positionHint.defaultMessage: Where they stand in the list, lowest first.
positionHint.description: The hint under the position field: how the position orders the list.

photo.description: The label of the field for the address of a staff member's photo.

email.description: The label of the field for a staff member's email address.

phone.description: The label of the field for a staff member's phone number.

bio.description: The label of the field for the text of a staff member's own page.

bioHint.description: The hint under the bio field: how the bio is written, and where it is shown.
